messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Take the missed oral levothyroxine dose as soon as you remember, and then go back to your regular schedule. Do not use two doses at one time.

The relation 'route of administration' in the triplet is defined as 'The method by which the subject drug is delivered to the body is the route specified by the object entity.' Choices:
A. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
